pipeline.title: The pipeline
pipeline.lede: How a plan is built, shaped, explained, read for load and adapted, and where the numbers come from.

nodes.label: Goal and baseline
nodes.note: The goal profile, target date, baseline (recent time, weekly volume, experience, age), available days, kit and schedule.

nodes.label: Onboarding
nodes.note: Collects the goal and baseline and posts the plan request.

nodes.label: Engine generation
nodes.note: Deterministic: the phase arc, the weekly volume and long-run curve, VDOT paces, and every session. It computes every number.

nodes.label: AI shaping pass
nodes.note: Reads the engine's plan and chooses typed intents only. An answer outside the set is dropped.

nodes.label: Stored plan
nodes.note: The goal, plan, weeks and sessions written to D1.

nodes.label: Reason pass
nodes.note: Rewords each session's reason after the plan is saved, in the background, and keeps the deterministic reason as the fallback.

nodes.label: Load model
nodes.note: Reads the plan and the runner's logs in shadow, and can only ease or hold a future week.

nodes.label: Adapt
nodes.note: Rebuilds only the weeks that have not started, seeded with real recent volume and feedback.

nodes.label: UI surfaces
nodes.note: Today, Week, Coach and Progress render the stored plan and convert units at the edge.

edges.label: typed intents, applied inside the engine's bounds
writes goal, plan, weeks and sessions

paths.title: Every path a plan takes
paths.lede: Each trigger, the decision points it crosses, and the tables it writes.

nodes.label: Create a plan
nodes.note: Onboarding submit, and the admin rebuild on a user's behalf.

nodes.label: Preview a plan
nodes.note: A dry run on the same engine that stores nothing.

nodes.label: Rebuild later weeks
nodes.note: The runner approves an edited first week and asks for the rest to match it.

nodes.label: Adapt the plan
nodes.note: The runner asks to bring the plan in line with their recent training.

nodes.label: Change the goal
nodes.note: A new goal profile or target date is saved.

nodes.label: Log a run or mark a session
nodes.note: A finished session is logged, or a session is marked started or skipped.

nodes.label: Connection sync
nodes.note: The cron pulls new activity and daily health from a linked account.

nodes.label: Provider push
nodes.note: The provider tells us something changed and the webhook only asks for a sync.

nodes.label: Nightly and weekly cron
nodes.note: 0 7 daily and 0 8 on Monday. Writes the coach note and runs the connection syncs.

nodes.label: Answer in the closed set?
nodes.note: A quality kind and a volume, strength and mobility intent of ease, hold or build. An out-of-set answer is dropped.

nodes.label: Load model mode?
nodes.note: shadow records and changes nothing. advisory and apply are opt-in per runner, and off turns it off.

nodes.label: Does a lower intent win?
nodes.note: Load may ease or hold, never build. A stricter intent beats an AI build, never the other way.

nodes.label: Does an activity match a session?
nodes.note: Proposed until the runner confirms or rejects it, kept so it is not proposed again.

nodes.label: Engine computes every number
nodes.note: A model never writes a distance, a pace or a count.

nodes.label: Load may ease or hold, never build
nodes.note: No path raises a week above the engine's own curve.

nodes.label: user_goals
nodes.note: The chosen goal profile per runner, with the target date and baseline.

nodes.label: plans
nodes.note: One row per generated plan, with its params and status.

nodes.label: plan_weeks
nodes.note: Each week's phase, focus and dates.

nodes.label: sessions_plan
nodes.note: Each prescribed session, with its prescription and reason.

nodes.label: logs
nodes.note: A runner's logged session, with its stats and feedback.

nodes.label: activities
nodes.note: An activity pulled from a connector, with its match state.

nodes.label: session_states
nodes.note: Per-session started or skipped state, kept on the server.

nodes.label: connections
nodes.note: A linked account, its encrypted tokens and its sync watermark.

nodes.label: summaries
nodes.note: A cron-generated coach note, nightly or weekly.

edges.label: writes the activity and match state
writes the nightly or weekly note

modules.label: Plan engine
modules.computes: The phase arc, the weekly volume and long-run curve, VDOT paces, and every session's distance, pace and count.
modules.mayDecide: The phase shape and every number. Nothing here is model-authored.

modules.label: Load model
modules.computes: Fitness, fatigue and form curves from the plan and the runner's logs, and a readiness score.
modules.mayDecide: To ease or hold a future week. Never to build, and never a number.

modules.label: Plan-change pipeline
modules.computes: The typed, confidence-scored decisions (volume intent, quality-day count, long-run delta) and the mapping onto a week's shape.
modules.mayDecide: Which weeks change and by which typed intent. An out-of-set answer is dropped.

modules.label: AI shaping pass
modules.computes: One bounded request per plan that asks the model for a quality kind and volume, strength and mobility intents.
modules.mayDecide: Nothing on its own. Every answer is validated, and the deterministic plan stands when it fails.

modules.label: Session reason composer
modules.computes: Each session's and week's reason from the plan's own decisions, with no invented numbers.
modules.mayDecide: Which true sentences to include. A fact the plan does not carry is left out.

modules.label: Reason rephrase gate
modules.computes: A gate that keeps a reworded reason only when it adds no number the deterministic reason did not have.
modules.mayDecide: Whether a reworded line is kept or dropped.

modules.label: Session reason pass
modules.computes: The batched model call that rewords session reasons after a plan is saved, and the store step.
modules.mayDecide: Nothing about the plan. It replaces a reason's text only when the gate keeps it.

modules.label: Adapt
modules.computes: Rebuilds only the weeks that have not started, seeded with real recent volume and feedback.
modules.mayDecide: The shape of the future weeks, inside the engine's own bounds.

modules.label: Week-one rebuild
modules.computes: The rest of the plan from the runner's approved first week: its days, session types and added workouts.
modules.mayDecide: The pattern the later weeks follow. Week one itself is never touched here.

modules.label: Schedule placing
modules.computes: Each session's start time inside the runner's saved windows, moving a session only when its own day cannot hold it.
modules.mayDecide: Only a day and a start time. No distance, volume or training maths.

modules.label: VDOT paces
modules.computes: Training paces from a race time or an effective VDOT.
modules.mayDecide: Nothing. It is pure maths.

modules.label: Onboarding suggestions
modules.computes: Recommended onboarding values, each with a plain reason.
modules.mayDecide: Nothing. It suggests a starting point.

modules.label: Coach safety classifier
modules.computes: A typed risk read (none, caution, urgent) with a confidence, for a coach message.
modules.mayDecide: Whether to redirect on a confident, non-none risk. It never diagnoses.

modules.label: Model router
modules.computes: Time-boxed model calls: Cloudflare Workers AI first, OpenRouter on error or timeout.
modules.mayDecide: Nothing. Callers decide, and every path degrades on failure.

modules.label: Connection sync
modules.computes: Pulls new activities and daily health from a linked account and matches activities to planned sessions.
modules.mayDecide: Which activity matches which session, proposed until the runner confirms.

modules.label: Connection security
modules.computes: Encrypted token storage and the signed OAuth state.
modules.mayDecide: Nothing. It stores and refreshes tokens.

modules.label: Cron handlers
modules.computes: The nightly and weekly coach note, and the connection syncs.
modules.mayDecide: When the note and the syncs run.

modules.label: Plan routes
modules.computes: Thin Hono handlers for generate, preview, adapt, rebuild, load and session state.
modules.mayDecide: It validates input and calls the pure logic. It holds no plan maths.

modules.label: Admin surface
modules.computes: Reads metadata only: users, plans, the load model's shadow records, and app errors.
modules.mayDecide: Admin state and the audit trail. It never changes a plan's numbers.

modules.label: Data model
modules.computes: The Drizzle tables, indexes and references.
modules.mayDecide: Nothing. It is the shape of what is stored.
